switzerland/None.text:
Decision: Adopted on 19 July 2024 by the Security Council unanimously (15 votes in favour). Scope: Replaced the 1730 delisting procedure and directed sanctions committees other than the 1267 Committee to revise their guidelines. The Secretary-General was instructed to appoint a new Focal Point within three months, in consultation with the working group.

Statement: Switzerland called the independent Ombudsperson mechanism for the 1267 regime an ideal model and welcomed the strengthened Focal Point as progress.

Relation: Switzerland's statement expresses a preference for the Ombudsperson model and welcomes the new Focal Point; this does not constitute an adopted requirement or decision by the Council.
